description.value: This study compared gray and white matter densities and cognitive performance among current cocaine users, cocaine abstainers, and nondrug-abusing controls, and examined relationships between cognitive performance and brain tissue density.

spans.text: The purpose of this study, therefore, was first to determine whether structural abnormalities documented in current cocaine users relative to well-matched nondrug-using controls were also present in individuals that have been abstinent from cocaine for over 1 month.
